description:
Live coverage of Cubi's per-listing enrichment data layers.

    Use for a data-pipeline dashboard: how many active listings carry each
    environmental / accessibility layer, the flood-risk band split, and the
    per-country share of listings in a modelled High (1-in-20-year) river
    floodplain.

    Returns:
        JSON string. Warm cache (exact, ~6h fresh): {active_listings, cached:
        true, computed_at, coverage:{noise, air_quality, greenery, coastal,
        flood, drive_time, campsite}, flood:{high, medium, low, none, at_risk},
        flood_by_country:[{country, n, high_pct}], climate_regions, str_areas,
        price_moves}. Before the first cache tick, a fast planner-stat fallback:
        {active_listings, approx: true, cached: false, coverage:{…}}.
name: data_layer_stats
title: Data-layer coverage
